name: abap2UI5
description: Developing UI5 Apps Purely in ABAP.

scripts.check:frozen: git fetch origin main --quiet && git diff --quiet origin/main...HEAD -- src/99 ':(exclude)src/99/*.testclasses.abap' ':(exclude)src/99/*.clas.xml' || { echo 'FAIL: src/99 production code is frozen (AGENTS.md rule 1) - revert changes under src/99 (test classes and .clas.xml sidecars are exempt)'; exit 1; }
scripts.check:app2abap: node .github/scripts/ensure-app-deps.mjs && npm run app2abap && git diff --exit-code -- src/01/03 app/webapp && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src/01/03 app/webapp)"
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check_visibility && npm run check:frozen && npm run check:guide && npm run check:formatter && npm run check:api && npm run check:standard && npm run check:cloud && npm run downport && npm run auto_transpile && npm run unit && npm run check:js && npm run check:app2abap
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm --prefix app ci && npm run check:ui5 && npm --prefix app run lint
scripts.syfixes: find node/downport -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.downport: npm run deps && rm -rf node/downport && cp -r src node/downport && npm run downport_config && abaplint --fix .github/abaplint/downport_run.jsonc && npm run syfixes && npm run strip_trailing_ws
scripts.auto_downport: npm run downport && cp -r node/downport/. src/ && cp -f .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc abaplint.jsonc && npm run abaplintpathfix
scripts.app2abap: npm --prefix app run format && npm run auto_app2abap && npm run auto_abaplint
scripts.auto_transpile: rm -rf node/output && cp node/srv/*.abap node/srv/*.clas.xml node/downport && abap_transpile ./node/setup/abap_transpile.json
